description: Roll out distributed tracing across 12 microservices using OpenTelemetry. Must: instrument all services with OTel SDK, deploy Jaeger collector, configure exporters, add trace correlation IDs to logs, set up alerting on p99 latency anomalies, and verify trace propagation across service boundaries. Risk factors: instrumentation overhead impacting performance, missing trace propagation headers causing broken traces, Jaeger storage costs, sampling rate too low missing critical traces. Tools available: OpenTelemetry SDK, Jaeger, Helm, kubectl, Prometheus.
